findings.issue: long_blurb uses the 2014-era figure '$19 per share into $146,186' (from the 2014 shareholder letter's 50th anniversary recap) without a date qualifier. By 2024, Berkshire's per-share book value was significantly higher. The figure understates rather than overstates, and is directly traceable to a corpus source, but reads as a current-state claim in a 2026-built persona.
findings.recommendation: Either add a parenthetical year ('turned $19 per share into $146,186 by 2014') or update to the most recent comparable figure from the 2024 letter if one exists. Low priority since it understates the track record.
findings.resolution: Added '(by 2014)' year qualifier to the long_blurb figure
